conclusions.topic: One-time parser transition before Head publication
conclusions.finding: native complete_frame checks expiry before parsing, which alone cannot guard parse/scheduling crossing. New complete_head_at must recheck the old Header deadline after Parser.feed and use the same captured Instant both for Head.admitted_at and Request deadline=admitted_at+120s; repeated Head/phase change must refuse. Observed in-progress helper does this.
requiredCoverage: Complete valid Head before original cutoff, defer caller body admission beyond old5s; Head/request remains valid under original120s.
Parser completion at/after old cutoff publishes no Head, closes exact slot, no positive route/body work.

conclusions.topic: Admission only narrows original120s, including30s voice
conclusions.finding: Do not recompute now+120 at admit/ACK/response. New admission_deadline_valid <= current deadline preserves original epoch; caller voice life is original admitted_at+30s. Existing http_index, drive, receive, send and complete_frame use common current deadline.
requiredCoverage: Body admitted after oldheader5s but before original120s succeeds.
Caller deadline later than current/original120s rejects; elapsed30s narrowed request cannot be widened/reopened.
Expired ACK/respond/send_response_body/set_response_fence rejects, while cancel remains possible.

conclusions.topic: Already published/queued events and late completions
conclusions.finding: Public Host.poll expires slots before taking queued events, and close_slot clears a queued Head/Body. Test both an unconsumed Head after oldheader5s (must survive) and after newrequest120s (must disappear and Closed be delivered). A cooperative check at poll start is not a hard-real-time guarantee across an arbitrary pause between poll and event take; TransferLifetime/job fences must still reject aged event work.
requiredCoverage: Late SSPI Plaintext after originalheader cutoff cannot establish Request phase.
Late result after narrowed request deadline returns original Frame but creates no Body/Head/ResponseReady or new positive submission.
Queued Head does not renew admitted_at at dequeue.

conclusions.topic: Logical timeout never releases physical slot
conclusions.finding: Keep pending IOCP charged after CancelIoEx/closesocket; keep unique Frame/SSPI context until actual return and same-token Retire confirmation. Expiry checks must not block negative Retire return branch, which currently precedes positive expiry handling. Rearm still requires physical socket/pending/frame/retired + delivered events, resets phase and clears response fence.
requiredCoverage: Hold real IOCP/fakeDriver in-flight across timeout: no new serial/owner before exact return+Retired.
Stopped queued Retire is not retirement; real worker close/reap still required.
Negative cancel/drain remains callable after deadline.

conclusions.topic: Scope and response guard limits remain explicit
conclusions.finding: This slice fixes valid-Head→request budgeting only. Existing post+5s/backlog renewal/strict firstTCP5s remains unresolved and production gate closed. Response authorization fence and exact original deadline remain checked before each positive chunk/WSASend; already submitted sends may only be physically settled, never retracted or treated as new authority. No new native threads/owners/queues.
requiredCoverage: Preserve existing response-fence revocation, partial-send ACK, HEAD terminal and explicit retirement regressions.
No ACK/chunk/late SQL result gets a fresh120s or bypasses original30s job/voice execution fences.
